messages.content:
You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 8 of 50 (script duration 78.0 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
E3: Banished from her mother's chapel and seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana is rescued by an imposing, scarred stranger who intervenes with lethal grace—and drops to one knee with a proposal that shocks high society.
E4: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.
E5: Formally disowned and stripped of her inheritance, Juliana is publicly humiliated when her stepmother throws her late mother's treasured ledger into the mud, but her rugged new husband defends her dignity and guides her away from her callous family.
E6: Seeking shelter from the cold rain, Juliana arrives at her new husband's modest woodland cottage and discovers an unexpected sense of peace beside the hearth.
E7: When Gerald and his spiteful companion arrive at the woodland cottage to mock Juliana's fallen status, her stoic new husband returns from the forest to silently send them fleeing.
Direct lead-in to E8: Picks up after Episode 7, where Alexander chased off Gerald and the mocking aristocratic visitors; quiet and intimacy now return inside the woodland cottage as evening approaches.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: As Juliana inspects her late mother's weathered herbal grimoire, Alexander bonds with her over rustic medicinal knowledge and war-worn memories, gently altering her perception of what true wealth means.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-3.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana seated at a rustic wooden table beside a daylight-lit window, gently touching an aged leather-bound book.
[L002 0.0-3.2] ACTION: Juliana delicately runs her fingertips across the embossed leather cover of the worn botanical volume, noticing its weathered state.
[L003 0.2-3.2] JULIANA (Gentle, Somber): "Some of the pages are ruined. Careful."
[L004 3.2-5.1] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's hands carefully unlatching the metal clasp on the leather book.
[L005 3.4-4.5] SFX: Soft metallic click of the book clasp loosening.
[L006 5.1-7.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana tenderly opening the cover and turning the brittle parchment pages.
[L007 5.1-7.8] JULIANA (Reflective, Reverent): "Mother spent years writing this."
[L008 7.8-10.5] SCREEN: Medium shot as Alexander enters the dim room behind Juliana, quietly stepping up to the rustic table.
[L009 8.5-10.5] ACTION: Alexander gently sets down a fresh bundle of small white herbal flowers tied with twine beside the open book.
[L010 10.5-11.9] SCREEN: Low-angle medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward Alexander in pleasant surprise.
[L011 10.5-11.8] JULIANA (Curious, Recognizing): "Yarrow."
[L012 11.9-15.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander looking down at her, the firelight catching the rugged scar across his face.
[L013 12.0-14.6] ALEXANDER (Calm, Knowledgeable): "Good for wounds. Fever, too."
[L014 15.0-16.3] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him with genuine curiosity.
[L015 15.1-16.1] JULIANA (Inquiring, Soft): "How do you know that?"
[L016 16.3-19.3] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander speaking in a steady, measured tone.
[L017 16.3-18.9] ALEXANDER (Somber, Matter-of-Fact): "Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive."
[L018 19.3-21.5] SCREEN: Insert shot of Juliana's hands gently arranging several tied bundles of dried yarrow sprigs on the tabletop.
[L019 19.4-21.8] JULIANA (Observant, Lightly Teasing): "You know more about healing than you let on."
[L020 21.5-24.3] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander, bathed in warm hearth embers, offering a subtle, knowing half-smile.
[L021 22.8-24.2] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Gritty): "Enough to survive."
[L022 24.3-26.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana setting down a bunch of flowers and looking intently at his rugged visage.
[L023 25.0-26.8] JULIANA (Hesitant, Soft): "Your hair and beard..."
[L024 26.5-28.1] SCREEN: Medium shot of Alexander standing tall over her, looking down patiently.
[L025 28.1-31.9] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as Juliana rises from her stool to stand close in front of him, reaching an affectionate hand toward his temple.
[L026 30.1-31.9] JULIANA (Gentle, Tender): "I could trim them for you."
[L027 31.9-33.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hand firmly but gently catching Juliana's wrist in midair.
[L028 33.2-35.5] SCREEN: Medium two-shot profile of Alexander holding her wrist, his piercing gaze locked onto hers.
[L029 33.2-34.5] ALEXANDER (Firm, Low): "Not yet."
[L030 35.5-37.3] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking into his eyes, her brow lightly furrowed in bemused question.
[L031 35.8-36.9] JULIANA (Puzzled, Curious): "Not yet?"
[L032 37.3-39.6] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander, still maintaining his gentle hold on her arm.
[L033 37.7-38.9] ALEXANDER (Grounded, Steady): "Let them grow."
[L034 39.6-42.3] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana smiling with playful warmth.
[L035 39.9-42.0] JULIANA (Playful, Amused): "You prefer looking like a forest hermit?"
[L036 42.3-44.9] SCREEN: Intimate two-shot as Alexander slowly lowers her hand, his expression softening.
[L037 43.7-44.9] ALEXANDER (Dry, Droll): "It has advantages."
[L038 44.9-46.9] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana chuckling quietly as she steps back toward the table.
[L039 45.5-46.8] JULIANA (Fond, Resigned): "Very well."
[L040 46.9-48.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander watching her with deep, affectionate attention.
[L041 48.0-50.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana grinning with sparkling eyes.
[L042 48.1-49.6] JULIANA (Teasing, Determined): "But one day, I am trimming that beard."
[L043 50.0-51.3] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander lowering his head slightly with a faint smirk.
[L044 50.1-51.2] ALEXANDER (Low, Amused): "We'll see."
[L045 51.3-53.3] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of both sitting back down at the table together, Alexander turning a brittle page of the herb book.
[L046 53.3-57.1] SCREEN: Close-up insert of Alexander's weathered finger pointing directly at a delicate botanical illustration of a flowering stem.
[L047 53.3-57.0] ALEXANDER (Instructional, Calm): "That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling."
[L048 57.1-59.8] SCREEN: Wide side-profile two-shot of Juliana and Alexander seated across from each other at the rustic table, the stone fireplace roaring warmly behind them.
[L049 58.7-60.2] JULIANA (Soft, Nostalgic): "My mother wrote the same thing."
[L050 59.8-63.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking across at his battle-marked features with empathy.
[L051 60.5-62.8] JULIANA (Hesitant, Compassionate): "And the scars... were they from the war?"
[L052 63.0-64.3] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander looking downward, memories clouding his eyes.
[L053 63.2-64.2] ALEXANDER (Quiet, Subdued): "Some were."
[L054 64.3-66.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with gentle understanding.
[L055 64.9-66.3] JULIANA (Tender, Aching): "It must have been terrible."
[L056 66.5-68.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Alexander lifting his gaze, heavy with past battles.
[L057 66.7-67.6] ALEXANDER (Heavy, Somber): "It was."
[L058 68.5-70.9] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of Juliana smiling tenderly at him across the open book.
[L059 69.0-72.1] JULIANA (Reflective, Vulnerable): "I thought losing wealth meant losing everything."
[L060 70.9-73.2] SCREEN: Wide shot framing the warm silhouette of the two companions sitting peacefully beside the blazing stone hearth.
[L061 73.2-78.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Juliana's radiant face illuminated by firelight, a peaceful, contented smile spreading across her lips as she looks at him until the shot gently fades out.
[L062 73.2-75.3] JULIANA (Quiet, Transformed): "Perhaps I was wrong."
[L063 75.3-78.0] ACTION: Juliana maintains her warm, peaceful gaze across the table as soft firelight flickers over her face into fade out.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}
